response.answer: Paul Baker is a leading researcher in gendered language, known for his extensive work on corpus-based studies of lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic variations. He has published numerous works and supervised several PhDs on related topics. His notable publications include "Using Corpora to Analyse Gender" and "Sexed Texts: Language, Gender and Sexuality."

results.title: Paul Baker | Lancaster University
results.content: Paul Baker is a Professor in the Department of Linguistics and English Language at Lancaster University. His research interests include corpus linguistics.

results.title: Paul Baker - Lancaster University
results.content: Books include: Using Corpora to Analyse Gender (2014), Discourse Analysis and Media Attitudes (2013), *Corpus Linguistics and Sociolinguistics* (2010), *Sexed Texts: Language, Gender and Sexuality* (2008), *Using Corpora in Discourse Analysis* (2006), *Public Discourses of Gay Men* (2005) and *Polari: The Lost Language of Gay Men* (2002). Previous PhDs I have supervised include:A corpus-based examination of the concept of political correctness in British broadsheet newspapers The language of marriage rituals in Botswana Combining corpus approaches and CDA to examine discourses of terrorism in the British and Chinese popular press Combining corpus approaches and CDA to examine discourses of homophobia in a right-wing political organisation A corpus study to compare lexical bundle use of Chinese learners of English with native speakers of English A corpus study of keywords to examine gender identity in British and Malaysian children's writingThe construction of gender identity in Iranian bloggersA corpus-based comparison of two academic books about Wahhabi Islam.
